playbookOutputs: Confirmation of the NHBRC registration fee paid by the client
playbookCommonFailures: Certified director IDs older than 3 months
Tax compliance status not 'Compliant' at SARS on the day of submission
Bank details in a director's name or older than 3 months
NHBRC registration fee (excluded from our fee) unpaid, so the application is not processed
Technical / construction competence questions unanswered — the NHBRC asks about the person responsible for construction and their experience

informationToProvide.label: Company registration documents (e.g., CIPC COR14.3)
informationToProvide.aiHint: CIPC CoR14.3 (or CK1/CK2) showing the registered name, enterprise number and directors. The NHBRC registers the company as the home builder.

informationToProvide.label: Certified ID copies of all directors/members - not older than 3 months
alternatives: Certified passport copy for a foreign director
informationToProvide.aiHint: Mandatory CIPC KYC Invariant: South African citizens MUST submit a certified SA ID (Smart ID Card front AND back, or Green Barcoded ID Book) certified within the last 3 months by a Commissioner of Oaths or SAPS — passports are NOT accepted for SA citizens. Foreign nationals ONLY may submit a certified/apostilled foreign passport accompanied by a valid visa/permit. Verify legible ID/passport number, full legal names, and certification stamp date within 90 days.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of business address
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, municipal account or lease in the company's name showing the physical business address, dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Valid Tax Clearance Certificate from SARS
informationToProvide.aiHint: SARS Tax Compliance Status PIN letter for the company showing 'Compliant' and unexpired. The NHBRC verifies the PIN.

informationToProvide.label: Business bank account details - not older than 3 months
informationToProvide.aiHint: Bank account confirmation letter from a registered SA bank in the COMPANY's name, dated within 3 months, with bank stamp or digital verification reference. A statement is not acceptable.

informationToProvide.label: Details of the person responsible for construction (name, qualification, years of experience)
informationToProvide.aiHint: The NHBRC application asks who will manage construction and about their technical experience. Capture name, ID number, qualification / trade and years in home building. ⚠ verify whether the NHBRC currently requires a technical competence assessment or proof of previous projects for new registrations.

informationToProvide.label: Company Contact Email, Telephone & CSD Supplier Number (MAAA... if registered)
informationToProvide.helpText: Provide the company primary email address, cellphone number (for NHBRC portal notifications and technical test booking), and CSD MAAA number if registered.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect NHBRC registration requirements from client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: CoR14.3, certified IDs, proof of address, TCS PIN, bank letter and construction-manager details received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Chase only what is missing; name each document and why the NHBRC needs it (the NHBRC registers home builders so that homes can be enrolled under the warranty scheme). Remind that certified IDs, proof of address and the bank letter must be within 3 months and in the company's name. Ask who will be responsible for construction and their experience. Remind that the NHBRC's registration fee is payable by the client and excluded from our fee. Do not promise a shorter turnaround than 10–15 working days.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify documents against NHBRC requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All required uploads pass the rules engine or are approved by Kevin; TCS valid
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: The applicant is the company, never the ordering contact. CoR14.3, proof of address and bank letter in the company's name and agreeing on the registered name. Director names must match the certified IDs; certification within 90 days. Read the TCS PIN and expiry. Extract enterprise number, income tax number, address, directors with ID numbers, bank details and the construction manager's details.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Prepare NHBRC application hand-off sheet and POA
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Hand-off sheet with every NHBRC application field and a POA posted for Kevin's review
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Mirror the NHBRC home builder registration application (⚠ verify the current form / online portal fields): enterprise details, directors and shareholding, physical / postal address, contact person, bank details, TCS PIN, type of building activity, person responsible for construction and experience, previous NHBRC registrations if any. Special POA on My Accountant letterhead authorising Kevin Freese (CIBA #3561) to lodge and follow up the application. Never invent experience or qualification details — leave blank and flag.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send application and POA to client for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Signed application declaration and POA uploaded by client
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the approved documents with plain instructions: a director signs the application declaration and the POA, returns as PDF. Also give the NHBRC fee amount and payment reference once known — no deadline threats.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Submit registration on the NHBRC online portal
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Application submitted with uploads, reference number and fee reference recorded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: ⚠ CHANNEL: plan §4.4 marks this ⚠ — confirm with Kevin whether new home builder registrations are captured on the NHBRC online portal or lodged at an NHBRC provincial office / by email. Stage the application with all uploads (CoR14.3, certified IDs, proof of address, TCS, bank letter, POA, signed declaration) for Kevin to submit. Record the application reference and the NHBRC fee invoice; draft a client message with the fee details.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for NHBRC approval and follow up
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: NHBRC certificate and registration number received, or a query raised
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Draft a status query quoting the application reference at each follow-up point. If the NHBRC requests a technical assessment or further proof, create a proposal for Kevin with the request text and prepare a client message.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver NHBRC certificate and number to client
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate and registration number posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Post the certificate and number. Explain in plain English that registration is renewed annually (⚠ verify) and that every new home must be enrolled with the NHBRC before construction starts, with the enrolment fee paid per home.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
